description: Generate one music or speech/voice request and render it in the generation widget. This tool accepts one request: `text` for speech and sound effects, `prompt` for a song in Quick mode, `music_style` and `title` for one in Lyrics mode. DEFAULT speech model: elevenlabs-tts-v4 — use it unless the user explicitly asks for a different engine. To use a specific named engine instead, set model:'elevenlabs-tts-v2' and pass voice. Get voice ids from list_voices; use list_models(type:'audio') to inspect each model's params. When the catalog exposes suno-v6, use it for music. For sound effects use elevenlabs-sfx with text and duration in seconds. estimate_only:true preflights tokens without submitting. Submitted audio requests can send text to external audio model providers through aicut and consume tokens. On a transport timeout the submission outcome may be unknown: do not automatically resubmit. Reuse returned job IDs and retry only after the original outcome is known. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_only: true`, state the price in the same message as your ask, wait for a go naming THIS purchase (SPENDING RULES: `get_recipe` `spending-rules`).

custom_mode.description: Song: true = Lyrics mode (needs `title`; takes `lyrics`, `vocal_gender`, `duration_seconds`); omit = Quick (needs `prompt`).

duration.description: Duration in seconds. Follow the model catalog: Suno takes `duration_seconds` instead (Lyrics mode). Omit for models without a duration parameter.

estimate_only.description: If true, return the cost in tokens for this generation without submitting any job. Use to preflight cost before generating.

lyrics.description: Song, Lyrics mode: words to sing; omit to have them written; '[Instrumental]' for no singing.

model.description: Audio model ID from the model catalog (required). Use list_models(type:'audio') to discover.

prompt.description: Text prompt for the generated audio.

prompt_influence.description: Sound effects: how literally to follow the text (the model's `min`/`max`).

similarity_boost.description: Speech, `elevenlabs-tts-v2` and `-v4` only: how closely the delivery sticks to the voice.

speed.description: Speech, `elevenlabs-tts-v2` only: speaking rate, 1 is normal.

stability.description: Speech: how steady the delivery is (lower more expressive, higher flatter).

studio_run_id.description: The open studio run's `run_id`; null = outside it; covered only under its run ticket, else its own priced ask.

style.description: Speech, `elevenlabs-tts-v2` only: how far the speaker's own style is exaggerated.

text.description: Speech: the exact words to speak. Sound effect: a description of the sound.

title.description: Song: the title (required in Lyrics mode).

vocal_gender.description: Song, Lyrics mode: singer voice (a preference).

voice.description: For speech models: the voice id.

name: generate_audio
title: Generate AI audio
